---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

Do longer films get better rating? The @fig-runtime-rating plots each
film's runtime against its IMDb rating.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Runtime against IMDb rating"
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (min)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```

Below you will be able to find the mean rating of each decade.

```{python}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
